title: Inside an AI agent: how it works, in 60 seconds
description:
A 60-second animated tour of what happens after you ask an AI coding agent to fix a failing test.

1. The prompt: you type what you want.
2. Tokens: the text is split into tokens, and each token becomes a list of numbers.
3. Attention: each token weighs the tokens before it.
4. Prediction: the model predicts the next token, one at a time.
5. Tools: the agent runs tools, like the tests, and reads the result.
6. The loop: plan, act, check, repeat, until the checks pass.

The bars and numbers in the animation are an illustration, not real model values.

Animated in code with Claude, an AI assistant, by @hassanjan.k. Sound effects only, no music.
